title: A 12TB Steam "teraleak" spills more than a decade of lost PC gaming history
summary: A massive 12TB data breach dubbed the 'Steam teraleak' has exposed over a decade of lost PC gaming history from Valve's Steam platform, including unreleased games, prototypes, beta versions, and internal development files that were thought to be lost forever.
problem_solved: This incident highlights security vulnerabilities in gaming platforms while simultaneously preserving gaming history that would otherwise have been lost.
why_valuable: The leaked data provides invaluable insights into game development history, unreleased prototypes, and deleted content that holds significant cultural and historical value for the gaming community.
